jobs.title: Unarmed Retail Security Officer Weekend Patrols
jobs.description: Marksman Security is hiring a Retail Unarmed Security Guard in San Antonio. You will conduct extended foot and vehicle patrols, maintain a visible security presence, and protect people and property at North Star or La Cantera. Ideal candidates have a valid Texas Level II Guard License and a clean driving record, plus at least one year of customer service and security experience. The schedule includes weekend shifts with pay starting at $16.32 per hour, depending on experience.
